task_name: Check completeness, gaps, risks and review readiness
output_text: {"gaps":[{"gap_id":"GAP_001","missing_information":"Validation, verification, acceptance criteria, and test methods are not provided.","why_it_matters":"Without explicit validation evidence, downstream model generation can only produce unsupported verification artifacts and cannot justify testable requirements or acceptance-linked constraints.","suggested_human_action":"Confirm whether any test, acceptance, or verification criteria exist elsewhere; otherwise keep validation-related artifacts out of downstream generation."},{"gap_id":"GAP_002","missing_information":"Logical responsibility grouping and allocation of functions to logical elements are not described.","why_it_matters":"This limits derivation of a coherent logical architecture from the available capability and element list.","suggested_human_action":"Review whether the operator, remote expert, workstation, application, and client application should be grouped into logical components or treated only as named elements."},{"gap_id":"GAP_003","missing_information":"Deployment context, component ownership, and physical-to-logical allocation are not described.","why_it_matters":"Physical architecture candidates would be speculative without knowing what is deployed where and who owns each element.","suggested_human_action":"Determine whether deployment/topology details are available from another source before modeling physical structure."},{"gap_id":"GAP_004","missing_information":"Explicit interface definitions are missing, including source/target, direction, and exchanged data for session join, control request, and control grant/reject interactions.","why_it_matters":"Interface models need concrete interaction boundaries; otherwise only generic interaction candidates can be created.","suggested_human_action":"Ask for communication details or confirm that interface modeling should remain preliminary only."},{"gap_id":"GAP_005","missing_information":"The content of 'basic session information' is undefined.","why_it_matters":"Traceability/data artifacts cannot be modeled precisely without knowing which session attributes must be recorded.","suggested_human_action":"Clarify the minimum session data set expected for traceability."}],"ambiguities_and_risks":[{"risk_id":"RISK_001","topic":"System boundary","description":"The source names workstation, software application, client application, live image stream, control request, and session information, but does not say which are inside versus outside the system boundary.","potential_impact":"Could cause over-inclusion or under-inclusion of model elements and misuse of external context as internal structure.","suggested_review_action":"Confirm the intended system boundary before deriving structural models."},{"risk_id":"RISK_002","topic":"Meaning of remote control","description":"'Adjust the microscope view remotely' is stated, but the scope of control is not defined.","potential_impact":"Could lead to incorrect functional decomposition or overly broad control behavior in the model.","suggested_review_action":"Clarify whether control is full, partial, or limited to view adjustments."},{"risk_id":"RISK_003","topic":"Control ownership visibility","description":"The system must show who currently has control, but the audience and display context are unspecified.","potential_impact":"Could affect UI requirements and information-access modeling.","suggested_review_action":"Clarify whether control ownership must be visible to the operator, remote expert, both, or additional users."},{"risk_id":"RISK_004","topic":"Requirement strength","description":"Several statements use 'shall' and look requirement-like, but the source is explicitly informal and incomplete.","potential_impact":"A reviewer might overstate these as fully specified requirements rather than informal requirement candidates.","suggested_review_action":"Keep requirement-like statements as review-only candidates and preserve source wording."},{"risk_id":"RISK_005","topic":"Incompleteness of source","description":"The input explicitly says missing
